purpose: Review and generate a canonical, privacy-bounded service evidence JSON document containing statistical signal evidence, ranked hypotheses, limitations, optional software history and an offline-verifiable SHA-256 integrity digest.
primaryGoal: Choose a focal signal and analysis window for the selected workspace vehicle, review readiness and privacy, generate a defensible point-in-time evidence pack, copy its digest and download the exact previewed JSON. Neither the analysis nor digest is a diagnosis, causal proof or digital signature.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Existing workspace URL/store/first-vehicle precedence; vehicle identity and display name. Header vehicle scope remains enabled for this route.
dataSources.behavior: No local vehicle selector. Hooks are called before the no-vehicle return. The vehicle reference exported by the builder is reconstructed as id and displayName only.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Signal-history catalog read; normalized names only, not a source of current live measurements.
dataSources.behavior: Query key ['signals', vehicleId], enabled only for positive vehicle IDs, standard stale time, safeArray normalization and AbortSignal forwarding.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Independent historical responses and per-signal DataState identities; derived client-side root-cause analysis, not a backend diagnosis endpoint.
dataSources.behavior: At most eight trimmed/deduplicated identities; default 10000-point limit, bounded to 1-10000; hours bounded to 1-8760. Independent ['signal-evidence-history', vehicleId, signal, hours, limit] caches, cancellation, moderate stale time and no interval polling. Retained responses remain in aggregate data; failed/pending identities remain in sources. Resolved empty histories are marked unavailable.
dataSources.backendUnknowns: Handler execution, actual time-bound filtering, sampling/truncation/completeness and physical units of individual signal identities were not verified. The audit does not assert complete-range coverage or guess units.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Optional vehicle-scoped software update context, independently queried and trust-annotated.
dataSources.behavior: ['software-updates', vehicleId] key, nonempty ID enablement, snake_case vehicle_id, AbortSignal and safeArray. Builder normalizes version/status and installedAt or installed_at; unavailable context stays null, distinct from a known empty array. Server filtering and returned history completeness were not exercised.

dataSources.sourceOwnership: Pure domain derivation plus browser-local Web Crypto and Blob download; no server write or upload.
dataSources.behavior: Copies statistical evidence, ranked hypotheses, summary, quality, limitations and optional update context into schema 1.0.0. SHA-256 hashes recursively key-sorted core JSON, preserves array ordering and excludes the integrity block. Missing secure-context crypto throws CryptoUnavailableError; no weaker fallback.

components.contract: PageContainer props, inherited shell/header ownership and full-width min-w-0 container. PageContainer owns page title/focus target, query freshness metadata and announcements. This page passes the catalog query, not loading/error props that would replace all children.

components.contract: Typed StatMetric measurements; loading/error/retry, scope, source trust, summary and limitations. Four metrics with stable occurrence IDs; no replacement KPI engine.

components.contract: Catalog, loading/error/retry, focal signal and hours callbacks; default 72h, presets 24/72/168/720. GlassPanel, PanelTitle and two labeled native-backed Select primitives.

components.contract: state, label, hasChosenSignal, optional sources only. Complete identities, per-source sample counts, timestamps, loading/fatal/refresh/offline/unavailable states and retry; no summary or limitations props.

components.name: ServiceEvidenceInventoryTable
components.contract: DataTable with stable tableId diagnostics:service-evidence-signals and signal key. Five columns: signal, role, domains, samples, corroborating. Source-local unavailable counts render em dash/Unknown rather than zero.

components.name: ServiceEvidencePrivacyPanel
components.contract: Included/excluded constants from the actual pack builder, responsive two-column manifest and statistical-summary-only explanation.

components.name: ServiceEvidenceIntegrityPanel
components.contract: Generate with loading/disabled state, generation failure dismissal, digest/schema/time explanation, CopyButton with toast and Download JSON. Generated content is conditional within a persistent section shell.

components.name: ServiceEvidencePackPreview
components.contract: Shared CodeBlock with JSON language, wrapping, ariaLabel and max-h-96 pre; pre-generation guidance remains visible.

components.name: GlassPanel / PanelTitle / Text / Caption / Badge / Button / Select / CopyButton / DataTable / CodeBlock
components.contract: Reuse category barrel in feature consumers; semantic status variants, token-backed surfaces/text, current table persistence and existing clipboard/code pipeline. Do not create a competing card, table, formatter or overlay.

components.contract: Independent recovery and retained-content warnings, actionable onboarding guidance, generation errors and reduced-motion-aware entrance wrappers.

observations: PageLayout supplies w-full/min-w-0 and an allocated @container; no local maximum-page-width constraint.
Picker and privacy manifest stack below sm and become two columns at sm; digest/copy row stacks below sm and wraps its digest with break-all.
Signal names use break-all; preview wraps and caps the internal pre height.
All sections and actions are structurally retained; no mobile-only section deletion.

issues.detail: domains sets visibleOnMobile:false, but no column sets true and no mobileColumns prop is supplied. DataTable derives an allow-list from truthy values; an empty list becomes null (DataTable.tsx:714-725), so this flag does not hide the domains column. Actual strategy is all-five-column horizontal table scrolling, not column prioritization. Overflow and small-width usability are unverified.
issues.fix: Choose and document the existing DataTable scrolling/mobile presentation strategy explicitly. Preserve access to all five fields; do not merely add an allow-list that silently deletes domains from mobile. Exercise long signal/domain labels and the full details path before accepting a mobile alternative.
issues.confidence: high for source behavior; runtime unverified

responsive.viewports: 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560 not exercised; RTL, 200% text and long labels not exercised.

accessibility.verified: source inspection only; no keyboard, screen-reader or contrast exercise
observations: Metrics section has a localized aria-label; PageContainer owns the semantic page title and route focus target.
Shared Select supplies labels, hint association, native keyboard behavior and focus-visible styles; page passes translated labels.
Panel-header icons are aria-hidden; badges combine visible text and semantic variants instead of conveying state only by color.
Button forwards loading to aria-busy and disabled; preview provides a localized ariaLabel; per-source failures have role=alert and initial loading has role=status.
FadeIn.tsx:24-34 suppresses its initial transform and delay when useMotionPreference reduces motion. Browser/OS/low-bandwidth behavior remains unverified.

issues.detail: Generate and Download JSON opt into size=sm (also line 101). Current Button.tsx:39 uses h-9, nominally 36 CSS px; picker Select defaults to min-h-10, nominally 40 px (Select.tsx:34,47). These are below the contract's stronger 44px mobile default. Actual target dimensions/spacing exceptions were not measured; this is not a claimed WCAG failure.
issues.fix: Use existing sizing/class composition to achieve appropriate mobile targets while preserving density preferences and long-label reachability; measure real target geometry and any documented spacing exception.
issues.confidence: high for specified source sizing; effective targets unverified

states.initialLoading: Catalog picker uses Skeleton; initial history loading reaches the brief and inventory. Privacy, integrity guidance and preview remain mounted. Optional software history has independent warning/error presentation.
states.empty: No vehicle shows existing onboarding guidance. Empty catalog explains telemetry prerequisites. Unchosen focal signal retains inventory and generation guidance. Preview retains guidance before generation.
states.fatalError: Catalog and evidence failures have retry surfaces; updates failure has a separate QueryError panel. Main children are not placed behind a global data conditional.
states.refreshAndOffline: Retained histories are preserved by useSignalEvidenceBundle; complete source identities expose individual refresh errors, blocked refreshes, timestamps and retry. DiagnosticEvidenceBrief derives retained/partial labels from source states. Updates has its own StaleRefreshWarning.
states.generation: Chosen-signal + isAnalysisDefensible gates the visible generation button. generating supplies loading/disabled state. CryptoUnavailableError produces secure-context guidance; generic failures are dismissible. Download and exact JSON preview require a generated pack.

issues.rule: MDC-026/MDC-045; unknown or unavailable evidence is not measured quality
issues.detail: available tests aggregate entry presence, not nonempty historical evidence. The hook includes successful responses with data:[] in evidenceBundle.data while their sources are unavailable (useTelemetry.ts:266-280). The page consequently exposes an Insufficient evidence quality metric and corroborating count even when every resolved history is empty (lines 170-182), although inventory correctly withholds unavailable sample counts and focal hypothesis count is withheld. The brief also treats unavailable sources as partial (DiagnosticEvidenceBrief.tsx:35-37). This is an inconsistent source-trust presentation, not an actual measured zero.
issues.fix: Derive quality/corroboration availability from the complete historical source contract, retaining catalog inventory identities and existing analysis/export payload. Keep known empty, partial, pending and unavailable distinct; do not rewrite missing histories as zero or remove successful neighbors.
issues.confidence: high from source trace; not runtime reproduced

visualIssues.detail: Fixed text-cyan-300 decorates every panel-header icon without source/status meaning. Same styling occurs in inventory:87, privacy:27, integrity:47 and preview:23. It is less noisy than neon/glow, but repeats accent intensity and is not theme-semantic.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing neutral secondary/muted icon tokens for decorative headers; reserve semantic hue for actual quality, failure and export readiness. Retain icon meanings, labels and saved theme IDs. No new palette or global theme reset.
visualIssues.confidence: high for source pattern; composed contrast/visual appearance unverified

visualIssues.detail: Six sections use separate entrance wrappers with successive delays through 0.5s (last at line 293). Shared FadeIn already honors reduced motion, but the cascading reveal is decorative overhead for a technician's evidence workflow.
visualIssues.fix: Consider restrained entry timing through the existing FadeIn API, keeping every section and honoring saved/OS motion and low-bandwidth behavior. Do not introduce another animation owner.
visualIssues.confidence: high for source delays; perceived distraction unverified

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-002; mission 34; existing typed component contract
architectureIssues.detail: Inherited EvidenceSourceNotice invocation passes summary and limitations (lines 224-225), but EvidenceSourceNoticeProps defines only state, label, hasChosenSignal and sources (EvidenceSourceNotice.tsx:8-14). The renderer does not consume either extra prop. This is the explicitly assigned inherited prop error, reported only; no TypeScript run or source repair was performed.
architectureIssues.fix: In a separately authorized implementation, align this invocation with the current notice contract. Preserve narrative summary/limitations through their existing DiagnosticEvidenceBrief props at lines 255-256; do not widen the shared notice merely to silence this caller.
architectureIssues.confidence: high from both source contracts; compiler output unverified

architectureIssues.detail: The effect clears pack/error after a vehicle, focal signal or hours change (82-86), but an earlier async build still unconditionally calls setPack(doc) after awaiting crypto (105-111). Controls remain usable during generation. A scope change during the digest can therefore republish the old vehicle/signal/window document into the new page, with Download enabled whenever pack exists. Error/finally updates are likewise not generation-scoped.
architectureIssues.fix: Scope each generation result to a current request/snapshot identity and discard late success/error/finally results after scope changes or unmount. Preserve the deliberate point-in-time snapshot, digest algorithm, filename and normal generation gate; do not alter analysis calculations or disable workspace ownership.
architectureIssues.confidence: high from async source ordering; race not runtime exercised

architectureIssues.detail: Historical analysis window is local useState, default 72h; SignalWindowPicker.tsx:81-86 renders another date-window selector and queries send hours only. /diagnostics/service-evidence is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS (workspaceScope.ts:23-77), so the shared header range is currently hidden rather than a visible duplicate. The page does not consume useRangeState or URL from/to. Whether this specialist bounded analysis is an explicitly independent business window is not established in the inspected source.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner must reconcile this route with the shared range contract before modernization: retain the 24/72/168/720 presets/default semantics and bounded analysis, establish whether the window is independent, or adopt header scope with both bounds and server coverage. Do not merely register a header control the existing hooks cannot consume, filter only loaded points, or silently remove the current functionality.
architectureIssues.confidence: high for source wiring; medium for intended independent-window classification

architectureIssues.detail: Generated time uses new Date(...).toLocaleString() with browser defaults. Per-signal freshness repeats this at SignalEvidenceSourceList.tsx:51. Both bypass useDateFormat.ts:73-94, which resolves saved locale and timezone mode. Export timestamps are correctly retained ISO values; this concern is display only.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse useDateFormat.formatDateTime at the presentation boundary without changing generatedAt, updatedAt, canonical JSON or hash inputs.
